name: com.mud.modules.script-encoding-converter
description: Editor extension for converting script encoding between GB2312 and UTF8. 将脚本编码从 GB2312 转换为 UTF8 的编辑器扩展。Derived from the upstream project MUDV587/Script-Encoding-Converter (original author Bian Shanghai) with additional fixes and improvements. 本包基于上游项目 MUDV587/Script-Encoding-Converter（原作者 Bian Shanghai）优化改进。

samples.displayName: Encoding Test Scripts / 编码测试脚本
samples.description: Demo scripts in UTF8, UTF8 BOM and GB2312 encodings. Import to test the converter. UTF8 / UTF8 BOM / GB2312 编码的演示脚本，可导入后体验转码功能。
